generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of seeing your own studies that will serve you in every module from here. Each session you meet is designed to make you do something, each set of criteria tells you what your work must show, and each piece of feedback points to your next step. The habit to keep is simple: read what each task is asking, use the feedback you get, and let it shape the next piece of work.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you are given work, judged against a standard, and told how to improve, the people who get better are the ones who treat each round as feeding the next. The cycle you have learned to work with is one you will use long after you graduate.
